**U0005** - 2018 electoral platform (Juntos Haremos Historia coalition): "austeridad republicana" to redirect current spending to investment without raising taxes; addressing "causas sociales" (poverty, violence); gradual military withdrawal from internal security with 3-year "pacificación" goal; increasing domestic gasoline supply to cut imports and prices; energy and food self-sufficiency via guaranteed prices for local producers; "erradicación" of political corruption "by example"; migrant defense. These are pre-election stated policy planks for the 2018-2024 mandate window. They constitute named policy actions tied to 5B.1 (prosperity vs rents), 5B.3 (fiscal rules, budget reorientation), 5B.5 (anti-corruption platform), 5B.6 (infrastructure/social spending), 5B.9 (commodity/import-replacement strategy). Platform pledges are not executed outcomes, but they are concrete named policy actions with measurable promised instruments and a clear window — they meet the evidence test as attribution-of-intent facts that bear on 5B.1 and 5B.3.
- Decision: INCLUDE
- Lenses: 5B.1 (platform on rents vs broad-based prosperity: guaranteed prices, energy self-sufficiency, austerity-republicana redirecting current spending to investment), 5B.3 (fiscal framework: austerity republicana without tax increases, budget reorientation), 5B.5 (anti-corruption "by example" platform), 5B.6 (planned social/infrastructure spending targeting poverty and violence), 5B.9 (commodity/shock measure: domestic gasoline supply expansion to cut imports and prices; food self-sufficiency as price-shock buffer)
- Adjacent context: coalition composition (MORENA/PT/PES) relevant to 5B.2 appointments.

**U0006** - Platform details for 2018-2024: "socialdemocracia pragmática" assuming free market, macroeconomic stability, fiscal discipline, peso flotation, but rejecting "tendencias privatizadoras" and "extranjerización" of strategic sectors, prioritizing "producción nacional." Anticorruption promise "without vengeance" ("no voy a meter a Peña Nieto en la cárcel"). Conservative stances on abortion/same-sex marriage. Dec 1, 2018 inauguration with congressional majority. Pre-inauguration: Constitutional Morality discussion, Citizen Consultation on priority programs, National Peace and Security Plan with Guardia Nacional and "amnistia condicionada" for narcos; government studying decriminalization of soft drugs. This contains named policy actions tied to 5B.1 (platform pillars), 5B.3 (fiscal/monetary framework), 5B.5 (anti-corruption pledge without prosecution), 5B.6 (priority programs via citizen consultation).
- Decision: INCLUDE
- Lenses: 5B.1 (platform combination of orthodoxy + nationalist production priority), 5B.3 (explicit acceptance of macroeconomic stability, fiscal discipline, peso flotation combined with rejection of privatization/foreignization), 5B.5 (anti-corruption pledge: "justice without vengeance," explicit no-prosecution assurance for predecessor — bears on credibility of anti-corruption enforcement), 5B.6 (priority programs emerging from national citizen consultation, governance procedure)
- Adjacent context: inauguration congressional majority relevant to legislative capacity for 5B.1/5B.3; conservative social stance not material to 5B.

End-of-section note: text updated to 29 Nov 2018. Section table of contents follows. USMCA is a named trade-policy outcome tied to 5B.3 (trade rules) and 5B.9 (shock management). The Trump border threat and migrant visa offer are policy actions tied to 5B.4 (trade/migration policy) and 5B.9 (shock response).
- Decision: INCLUDE
- Lenses: 5B.3 (USMCA as executed trade framework with macroeconomic implications, AMLO's positive assessment), 5B.4 (trade/investment policy framework), 5B.9 (migrant caravan shock response: work-visa offer, border tension management under USMCA renegotiation pressure)
- Adjacent context: Ivanka/Pence attendance is protocol, not material.
